neel-marketing: Quick ask for publishing + demo tomorrow — can runtime produce a tiny 'minipack' (4 payloads + timings + 1 cold/1 steady trace) we can attach to the blog?

tess-runtime: Yep. Short list: 4 payloads (tiny, short, mid, long), timings.csv with p50/p95/p99, provenance line, README. Any infra prefs?

neel-marketing: Use rwd-demo-2b on dedicated-gpu-9 if possible. Sequence distro: 50% <=64, 30% 65-512, 20% 513-2048. Press will quote p95 over N requests so include N in provenance.

priya-eng: Also include sequence_length column in timings.csv and counts per bucket in README so marketing can compute weighted means.

tess-runtime: Will do. Plan: 400 requests, 40 warmup, batching disabled. ETA ~6h. I'll include demo/run-local.sh with exact curl and env var.

demo-team: Please make that curl copy-pasteable for laptop demos (no extra sed).

tess-runtime: Got it. Example included: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-demo-2b","input":"Summarize: ..."}'

neel-marketing: If int8 numbers are noisy, mark them 'experimental' and include raw traces. Do not let marketing publish noisy claims.

tess-runtime: Agree. We'll run fp16 baseline and int8 quick-check; if int8 p95 SD >10% vs fp16 mark noisy.

bench-bot: micro-bench #99731 queued by tess-runtime. Logs: /bench/99731.

neel-marketing: Thanks — if anything delays, flag us. We'll drop the long payload if needed. :pray:

bench-bot: micro-bench #99731 completed. Artifacts uploaded to /bench/99731/artifacts.tar.gz (sha256: e3b0c4...).
